fields.claim_id: cross-reference into claim_ledger.json claims[].claim_id, or null for narrative_continuity records
fields.adversarial_subfamily: list of spec subfamily tags this memory serves, e.g. ['05.2']
fields.canonical_claim: the claim text this memory is evidence for or against
fields.confidence_label: the STATED confidence at time of writing (see truth_state.json confidence_label_scale) -- not necessarily justified by the evidence
fields.evidence_role: one of independent_primary | derivative_copy | synthesis | context
fields.stance: one of supports | contradicts | neutral_observation, relative to canonical_claim
fields.source_authority: source's authority/role level, evidence metadata only (Invariant 05-C: not a truth signal)
fields.evidence_root: shared label across memories tracing to one underlying observation; null if this memory is itself an independent root or is pure narrative context. Used to compute claim_ledger.json's independent_evidence_roots.
fields.evidence_id: unique id (e.g. E003_2) referenced by claim_ledger.json supporting_evidence/contradicting_evidence

notes._oracle: Development-only metadata; strip for blind-system runs.
notes.null_scope: Null means not normalized/unspecified in the exposed record, not necessarily global.
notes.exp05_underdetermined: objective_status (in claim_ledger.json) may be 'underdetermined' -- an intentional, permanent ground-truth state per Invariant 05-E, not a placeholder.

exp05_extension_fields.must_surface_uncertainty: boolean; true when the correct answer requires explicitly flagging that the evidence does not justify a confident answer (spec section 9.6/section 7)
exp05_extension_fields.must_surface_conflict: boolean; true when the correct answer requires surfacing that evidence conflicts (as opposed to being merely incomplete)

claim_ledger_record.objective_status_note: May be 'underdetermined' (or a descriptive analogue like 'unsupported') where the story itself never supplies a decisive test. This is not a placeholder to be resolved in a future revision -- see Invariant 05-E.
claim_ledger_record.belief_states_shape: { 'YYYY-MM-DD': { actor_id: confidence_label } }, spanning at least one snapshot per claim with a meaningful belief trajectory.
